url.label: Application URL
url.description: The URL users access Attraccess at (used for redirects, links, and API callbacks).

publicInternetUrl.label: Public Internet URL
publicInternetUrl.description: Optional URL used for external callbacks (e.g. SumUp).

cookieSameSite.label: Auth Session Cookie SameSite Policy
cookieSameSite.description: Controls when the auth session cookie is sent with cross-site requests. The SSO state cookie (used during OIDC / SAML login) is always 'Lax' regardless of this setting.

lax.label: Lax (recommended)
lax.description: Session sent on top-level navigation. Email notification links and external links keep the user logged in.

strict.label: Strict
strict.description: Session not sent on any cross-site navigation. SSO login itself still works, but users will appear logged out when following links from emails or external sites.

none.label: None
none.description: Session sent on all cross-site requests. Requires HTTPS (Secure flag).

licenseKey.label: License Key
licenseKey.description: Paste a new license key to update.
